headlines.description: Arsenal struck twice in eight second-half minutes to secure a comeback 2-1 win against Leeds at the Emirates Stadium and move level on points with Manchester City at the Premier League summit.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal come from behind to overcome Leeds

headlines.description: Kristoffer Ajer's second-half equaliser ensured Brentford continued their unbeaten start to the Premier League season in an entertaining 2-2 draw at Aston Villa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brentford stay unbeaten after compelling Villa draw

headlines.description: Jordan Henderson was the unlikely hero as Chelsea's entertainers blew Bournemouth away in a comprehensive and chaotic 5-1 win at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson, 36, nets unlikely brace as Chelsea thrash B'mouth

headlines.description: Ipswich produced a dramatic turnaround to beat Fulham 2-1 after late goals by Abdoul Ouattara and Dara O'Shea extended Alvaro Arbeloa's winless start to six Premier League matches.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ipswich bag late dramatic victory against Fulham

headlines.description: Maxim De Cuyper and Jaouen Hadjam were both on the scoresheet as 10-man Brighton clinched a 2-0 win over Sunderland at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brighton keep pressure on City, Arsenal with win

headlines.description: Dominic Solanke capitalised on weak Manchester United defending as winless Tottenham recovered from Rodrigo Bentancur's dismissal to snatch a late 1-1 draw as boos filled Old Trafford once again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Solanke rescues point for 10-man Spurs as hapless Man United flatter to deceive again

headlines.description: Crystal Palace dealt former boss Oliver Glasner a blow after they bounced back to beat Nottingham Forest 3-1 on the Austrian's first return to Selhurst Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palace come from behind to beat Forest 3-1 and spoil Oliver Glasner's return to Selhurst Park

headlines.description: Hull retained their unbeaten home record since returning to the Premier League with an entertaining 2-2 draw against Everton at the MKM Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Belloumi maintains Hull's unbeaten home record

headlines.description: Uncertainty may surround Manchester City's future but nothing changed for them on the pitch as the Premier League leaders successfully came through their first public examination since their guilty verdicts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manchester City beat Liverpool with ease in first match after guilty verdicts

headlines.description: Coventry City picked up their first home victory in the Premier League for 25 years with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle United on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coventry stun Newcastle with emphatic 4-1 win

headlines.description: Pedro Neto scored twice in the second half to guide Chelsea to a 2-0 win at Everton on Saturday in a Premier League match marred by a serious-looking head injury to Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martínez.
headlines.shortLinkText: Neto helps Chelsea end Everton's unbeaten run

headlines.description: Alexander Isak marked his return from injury with the winner as Liverpool came from behind to beat nine-man Brentford 2-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Isak seals Liverpool comeback at 9-man Brentford

headlines.description: Fulham's winless run under Alvaro Arbeloa was finally ended by an entertaining 1-0 victory over Hull at Craven Cottage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arbeloa's Fulham earn first PL win of season

headlines.description: Erling Haaland struck twice as defiant Manchester City marched on at the top of the Premier League by holding on for a 3-2 win over Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland brace helps City hold off Ipswich at defiant Eithad

headlines.description: Johan Manzambi scored the only goal of the game as Aston Villa clinched a 1-0 win over Newcastle at St James' Park.
headlines.shortLinkText:
Manzambi fires Villa to victory at St. James' Park

Manzambi fires Villa to victory at St. James' Park

headlines.description: Evanilson scored and contributed an assist as Bournemouth comfortably beat 10-man Sunderland 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth ease past 10-man Sunderland

events.name: Crystal Palace at Brighton & Hove Albion

headlines.description: Diego Gómez sensationally scored from the halfway line as Brighton struck three goals in the opening 10 minutes en route to thrashing bitter rivals Crystal Palace 5-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Five-goal Brighton run rampant over rivals Crystal Palace

headlines.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin's second-half equaliser extended Manchester United's winless Premier League run to five matches as they were held 1-1 by rivals Leeds.
headlines.shortLinkText: Calvert-Lewin denies Man Utd first PL win since Aug. 30

headlines.description: Noni Madueke climbed off the bench to earn toothless Arsenal a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Madueke strike gives toothless Arsenal win at Forest

headlines.description: Tottenham Hotspur climbed off the bottom of the Premier League after James Maddison's superb 14th-minute opener inspired a 3-1 home win over Coventry City on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kulusevski returns as Spurs get first Premier League win of season

headlines.description: Liam Delap fired a blank on his return to Ipswich with Nottingham Forest forced to settle for a 1-1 draw despite a dominant display at Portman Road.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ipswich earn draw with Forest as Delap misfires on return

headlines.description: Nicolas Jackson scored twice to lead Aston Villa to a 2-1 win over Manchester City.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City beaten by double from Villa's Jackson

headlines.description: Centre-back partners Ezri Konsa and Gabriel celebrated personal milestones as Arsenal beat Everton 2-0 to move level on points with Premier League leaders Manchester City.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal's Konsa and Gabriel score to deny Everton

headlines.description: Oscar Bobb's first Premier League goal for Fulham earned a 1-0 win over Coventry that lifted the Cottagers clear of the relegation zone.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fulham out of relegation zone by beating Coventry

headlines.description: Cole Palmer was sent off as Chelsea fell to a 2-0 defeat to Tottenham at Stamford Bridge on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer sent off as Spurs get 2nd-ever Prem win at Chelsea

headlines.description: William Osula and Harvey Barnes scored early in the second half at Selhurst Park as Newcastle dealt Crystal Palace a frustrating 2-0 Premier League defeat to pile more pressure on Pierre Sage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palace's Sage under scrutiny as Newcastle win

headlines.description: Hull's unbeaten home record remains intact but the Tigers have not tasted victory for seven games after a 1-1 draw with Brentford at the MKM Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull unbeaten run remains, Brentford snatch draw

headlines.description: Liverpool's expensively-assembled front four finally clicked into gear as they beat Brighton 2-0 to record their first home Premier League win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool see off Brighton 2-0 as Reds' attack clicks

headlines.description: The pressure on Michael Carrick grew as Manchester United slumped to a limp 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carrick woe worsens, United lose to Bournemouth

headlines.description: Sunderland and Leeds were forced to share the spoils in a goalless stalemate at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland stay bottom after goalless draw with Leeds

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Manchester City
